title: 云计算产业结构分析：AWS、Salesforce、Google Cloud、Azure和火山引擎的进展
core_insight: AWS、Salesforce、Google Cloud、Azure和火山引擎在云计算和SaaS领域取得了显著进展，尤其是在AI、数据分析和网络安全方面

dimension_texts.infrastructure: AWS推出了新的定价模式和区域扩张，Google Cloud推出了新型定价模式 AWS推出了新的计算资源和存储解决方案，Google Cloud推出了新型计算资源 AWS Weekly Roundup: What’s Next with AWS 2026, Amazon Quick, OpenAI partnership, and more AWS Interconnect is now generally available, with a new option to simplify last-mile connectivity Cluster-level reliability for trillion-parameter models on TPUs
